description: List all documents, optionally filtered by status (draft|sent|partially_signed|completed|cancelled|expired). Sorted by uploaded_at descending.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of document summaries.

description: Retrieve the full document record by docid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full document record.

description: Upload a new document. New documents start in the 'draft' status.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new document summary.

description: Permanently delete a document, all its signature requests, and any signatures on those requests.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {docid, deleted: true, removed_requests, removed_signatures}.

description: Send a document to one or more signers. Creates one pending SignatureRequest per signer and transitions the document to 'sent'.

docid.description: Document identifier (must be in draft or sent).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {docid, requests: [...]}.

description: Cancel a document. Any still-pending signature requests are marked expired.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated document summary.

description: List signature requests, optionally filtered by document_id and/or status. Sorted by sent_at ascending.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of request summaries.

description: Retrieve a signature request by srid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full request record.

description: Sign a pending signature request at (page, x, y) with a signature image hash. Auto-refreshes the document status to partially_signed or completed as appropriate.

page.description: Page number where the signature is placed.

image_hash.description: Hash of the signature image blob.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new signature record.

description: Decline a pending signature request. The request transitions to 'declined'.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated request summary.

description: List signature records, optionally filtered by document_id (all signatures on that doc's requests). Sorted by signed_at.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of signature records.

description: List audit events, optionally filtered by document_id. Sorted by timestamp ascending.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of audit events.

description: Manually record an audit event on a document (for arbitrary actions such as reminders or comments).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new audit event.

description: List all signature requests currently pending for a specific signer.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of pending request summaries for that signer.

description: Search documents by keyword across title, filename, and uploaded_by.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of matching document summaries.

description: List all documents whose status is 'completed'.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of completed document summaries.

description: Return e-signature statistics: totals for documents, requests, signatures, audit events, plus counts by document status and by request status.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a stats dictionary.
